g.text: Troubleshooting
Problem
What to check
Errors about the | symbol in
type hints
You are using a Python older than 3.10. Update Python and install again.
ValueError: Unclosed marker,
SyntaxWarning: invalid escape
sequence, or markers that
show up literally or toggle a
style by accident
See Text Markers: they only work in paragraphs and table cells, and a literal marker
needs a backslash before each of its characters, written in a raw string.
The image is missing or fails to
load
The path is read when you run the script, relative to the folder you run it from.
Check that the file exists there.
A title, a subsection or a very
long word goes past the border
Titles and subsections stay on a single line, and a word bigger than its space
cannot fit. Shorten the text, reduce the font_size or increase the width.
Words are broken in the middle
inside a table or a column
A narrow column cannot fit a long word, so it is broken. Give that column a larger
weight, shorten the text or increase the width of the block.
Lines break earlier or later than
expected
The width of the text is estimated with the Arial font. On a system without Arial the
browser uses another font, so lines can look slightly different.
TypeError: unexpected keyword
argument 'loop_limit', 'easing',
'fade' or 'focus'
Not every animation takes every parameter. Only ambient animations and
Sequence take loop_limit. PopIn, PopOut, FlickerIn, FlickerOut, GlitchIn, GlitchOut,
Show and Hide have a fixed timing and no easing: change the duration. FadeIn,
FadeOut, Flicker and Glitch have no fade or focus.
TypeError: a step must be an
animation, or easing must be
an Easing
Animations and easings are objects, so they need parentheses: RiseIn(), not
RiseIn, and EaseOut(), not EaseOut. Names in quotes, such as "rise" or "ease-out",
are not accepted.
The loop_limit of my sequence
does nothing
When the last step is infinite, the sequence never reaches its end, so it cannot
repeat. Use a finite last step.
The animation does not play
Open the file in a browser and reload the page: without a loop, an animation plays
once when the image loads, and some image viewers do not play animations. To
replay it, see Repeating. Nothing plays for people who turned on reduce motion.
An ambient animation plays
once, or stops moving after a
while
Ambient animations play once by default: use loop_limit=4 for five runs or
loop_limit=None for no limit. Shake and Jelly also lose strength on purpose and stop
after a few swings: use shakes or wobbles to lengthen them.
The block disappears and
never comes back
An exit ends with the block hidden. To bring it back, put an entrance after it in a
Sequence, or make the sequence infinite with loop_limit=None.
The block jumps between two
steps of a sequence
svgblock does not blend the steps of a sequence: each one starts from its own
state. Choose steps that fit together, or separate them with a Show step.
The block is cropped while it
moves
The block is only visible inside the image. Entrances and exits come from outside it,
so they can start or end cropped. With fade=False, a large distance makes the
block start outside the image. Reduce the distance or keep the fade on.
The block looks smaller than
width, or the image is much
taller with Rotate
Animations that make the block bigger than normal (Pulse, Jelly, Glitch, or Zoom
with a scale above 1) and ambient animations that move, turn or blur it get room
inside the image, so the block rests smaller than width and is never cropped. Rotate
asks for the most: a full turn needs room for a whole circle. Use a smaller angle, as
in Rotate(angle=30), or Sway.
A theme changed in blocks
where I did not expect it, or my
theme edit has no effect
Theme.NAME.value.update(...) changes the shared theme for the whole program,
and only blocks drawn after the change use the new colors. To change a single
block, edit a copy made with Theme.NAME.value.copy(). Check also that the color
name is spelled exactly as in ThemeData.
The block does not show on my
page
Check that the path in the img tag matches the file name exactly (paths are case
sensitive on most servers, including GitHub) and that the .svg file is published
together with the page.
